data.title: DreamCatcher: Your Personalized Dream Journey
data.description: A personalized dream journaling and analysis app that helps users understand their subconscious through dream tracking, visualization, story generation, and exploration of potential influences.
data.builderPrompt: Create a website where users can track their dreams on a daily basis. AI can analyze the dreams, visualize the dreams, create the dream into a longer story, and also search the internet to check if anything the user has watched or seen could have influenced their dream. In addition, users can take notes on their dreams and also track their moods over time in relation to their dreams. The app can analyze correlations between their emotional states and dream content.
